report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Green Mountain Water Company

sources_described: Water Well: Well 4300560-001, Shady Brook Ln. The report states 'The water source is not considered most vulnerable to low density.'
search_log: WebSearch "Green Mountain Water Company" Morgan Hill consumer confidence report -> nothing for this system (greenmountainwater.specialdistrict.org is a Colorado district; City of Morgan Hill reports otherwise)

Drinking Water Watch https://sdwis.waterboards.ca.gov/PDWW/JSP/WaterSystemDetail.jsp?tinwsys_is_number=4199&tinwsys_st_code=CA -> Consumer Confidence Reports tab lists 2025, 2024, 2023 Report + Certification links on the State Water Board EAR portal

https://ear.waterboards.ca.gov/Home/ViewCCR?PwsID=CA4300560&Year=2025&isCert=false -> 10-page scanned PDF (EPSON Scan, no text layer), '2025 Consumer Confidence Report', report date February 09, 2026 -> used; values read from page images rendered with pdftoppm

extraction_notes: Scanned (image-only) PDF of the hand-filled state SWS CCR template; numbers were transcribed from page images rendered at 110 dpi, so leading-zero decimals ('.006', '.48', '.49', '.53', '.11', '.1') are as printed. The 'About This Report' paragraph says the monitoring period is Jan 1 - Dec 31, 2024, but the title is '2025 Consumer Confidence Report', the report is dated February 09, 2026, the E. coli row says 'Year 2025' and the lead/copper and nitrate samples are dated 2025, so data_year is recorded as 2025. Units are written in the 'Range of Detections' column instead of ranges. Table 6 (unregulated) is empty; Table 7 and Table 9 are 'None'; Tables 10-11 and the RTCR/variance sections are unfilled template text. Lead-specific language still contains '[NAME OF UTILITY]' placeholders.
